review_evidence: Repository unit contains 1,087 primary files: 931 canonical `*Script.sml` HOL4 theory sources, plus prover-facing ML libraries/interfaces and a small set of ordinary program/maintenance files.

All HOL theory scripts are retained. Prover-facing `Lib.sml`, `Syntax.sml` and `.sig` support is also retained conservatively because it can expose reusable theorem-manipulation/formalization interfaces even when it owns no new theory declaration.
The only hard exclusions are 28 executable compiler-benchmark inputs and three developer-maintenance utilities, each inspected as non-theory SML.

rules.content_invariant: All 12 reviewed files are ordinary executable SML programs (`fun main`, data structures/algorithms, benchmark harnesses, process exit) and contain no HOL theory/declaration commands. CakeML compiler semantics/proofs live in retained `*Script.sml` theory sources.
evidence: Inspected the complete 12-file manifest class; representative array_contain, bst_contain, btree, fib, nqueens, qsort, queue and reverse files are plain benchmark programs.
rules.rationale: This subtree contains standalone Standard ML benchmark programs used as compiler workloads, not HOL4 theory sources.

rules.content_invariant: All 16 reviewed files are standalone SML benchmark implementations/harnesses and contain no HOL theory/declaration commands; formal compiler correctness and benchmark compilation proofs remain in retained `*Script.sml` files elsewhere.
evidence: Inspected representative even-odd, fib, knuth-bendix, life, logic, pidigits, ratio-regions and smith-normal-form sources; they are executable SML benchmark programs.
rules.rationale: This subtree is an imported MLton/SML benchmark suite used as compiler workload input, not formal HOL4 source.

rules.content_invariant: They operate on files/build metadata and text; they do not define a CakeML/HOL theory or mathematical statement. Strings mentioning HOL syntax in readme_gen are lint rules, not declarations.
evidence: Complete fix_scripts.sml inspected: runs Holmake, locates failing scripts and patches source text.
Complete lint_build_dirs.sml role inspected: validates build-sequence/build-excludes directory metadata.
Complete readme_gen.sml role inspected: generates/checks README summaries and style rules.
rules.rationale: These exact files are CakeML repository-maintenance utilities for patching HOL scripts, linting build directories and generating/checking README summaries.

summary: Reviewed the CakeML corpus conservatively: formal HOL theories and prover-facing support libraries remain searchable; only unmistakable benchmark-program inputs and repository-maintenance scripts are removed from formalization search.
